hints: Follow the wire from the battery's plus end to the bulb. Can you find a way back to the minus end?
Electricity needs a full loop to flow, like cars on a race track. It leaves the battery, goes through the bulb and comes back to the other end. One wire leaves a gap in the track, so nothing flows.
Add the second wire, from the bulb back to the battery's minus end. Then press Run and watch the bulb.
